content: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information. CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm “in time for the holidays in December,” but he didn’t provide a price at the time. When he announced the Muse Charm, Zuckerberg said that the company had “packed the whole Muse experience,” including real-time voice and avatar technology, into the gadget. It has a fingerprint sensor, and you can tap it to be able to talk to a Muse AI agent without unlocking a phone or opening an app. The Information reports that the Muse Charm will come with a free 12-month 5G data plan from Verizon. Spokesperson Tyler Yee wrote to The Information that “We’re charmed by the interest in our AI devices, and we’ll have more to share soon.” When reached for comment by The Verge, Yee provided the same statement. The company is also working on a smartwatch, The Information says, but a launch for that has been pushed to 2027 as Meta tries to get Muse Charm out the door. Meta also open sourced code to let users make their own Muse gadgets, which my colleague Sean Hollister used to make his own DIY Muse Charm. Update, November 19th: Noted statement given by Meta spokesperson Tyler Yee.

chineseContent: 据 The Information 报道，Meta 计划将 Muse Charm 定价为 300 美元，这是一款带有屏幕的小工具，可以让你与 Muse AI 代理聊天。首席执行官马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 在今年早些时候透露了这款设备，并表示该公司预计将“在 12 月的假期前”发货，但当时他没有提供价格。当扎克伯格宣布 Muse Charm 时，他表示该公司已“将整个 Muse 体验融入其中”，包括实时语音和化身技术。它有一个指纹传感器，你可以点击它来与 Muse AI 代理对话，而无需解锁手机或打开应用程序。据 The Information 报道，Muse Charm 将附带 Verizon 的 12 个月免费 5G 数据套餐。发言人 Tyler Yee 在给 The Information 的信中写道：“我们被人们对我们的人工智能设备的兴趣所吸引，我们很快就会有更多的东西可以分享。”当 The Verge 联系到 Yee 寻求评论时，Yee 也做出了同样的声明。据 The Information 报道，该公司还在开发一款智能手表，但由于 Meta 试图推出 Muse Charm，该产品的发布已被推迟到 2027 年。 Meta 还开源代码，让用户可以制作自己的 Muse 小工具，我的同事 Sean Hollister 用它来制作自己的 DIY Muse Charm。 11 月 19 日更新：注意到 Meta 发言人 Tyler Yee 发表的声明。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
